title: Credit rights receivable registration succeeded
description: A credit rights receivable was successfully registered. The Create receivable endpoint generates this event.

debtor_document_number.title: Debtor document number
debtor_document_number.description: Debtor document number. A government document number, such as a Social Security number (US) or Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas number (Brazil).

face_value.title: Face value
face_value.description: Face value refers to the nominal or stated value of a financial instrument or asset, typically printed or stated on the instrument itself. It represents the initial value assigned to the instrument at the time of issuance or purchase

holding_number.title: Holding Number
holding_number.description: Holding number - The invoice number  + '.' + the number of installments.

ibge_code.title: IBGE Code
ibge_code.description: IBGE stands for Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística, which translates to the Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics. This Brazilian national statistical agency is responsible for collecting and providing official data on various aspects of the country. An IBGE code is a specific numerical code assigned to various administrative divisions and geographical areas in Brazil. Federative Unit + Town Name

internal_number.title: Internal number
internal_number.description: Client-assigned internal number used to manage credit rights receivable

interop_holding_number.title: Interop Holding Number
interop_holding_number.description: Credit rights receivable recurring code with letter

issuing_date.title: Issuing date

lender_document_number.title: Lender document number
lender_document_number.description: Lender document number. A government document number, such as a Social Security number (US) or Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas number (Brazil).

payment_method.title: Payment method
payment_method.description: Payment method. Number between 1-6. See detailed descriptions in Create receivable endpoint documentation.

owner_document_number.title: Owner document number
owner_document_number.description: Account owner document number. A government document number, such as a Social Security number (US) or Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas number (Brazil).
